$comment: Policy for dependabot-triage.yml. A repo absent here is never touched. verify_checks is an allowlist: only these check names vouch for a bump — deploy/preview/E2E jobs that cannot pass on Dependabot PRs (no repo secrets) are simply not listed. verify_checks [] = label-only, never merge. automerge stays false per repo until the repo has soaked in observe mode and, for production-deploying repos, a decision-log entry exists.

example-app-sdk-py.note: a repo-wide flaky check is deliberately not listed — add it back when fixed

example-app-sdk-go.note: a check that is red on recent Dependabot PRs — confirm it is red on main too, then add it

internal-docs.note: preview/production are secrets-gated deploys, not verification

example-app-web.note: production website — decision-log entry before automerge; preview/production are deploys

example-app-dashboard.note: deploy + E2E need secrets that Dependabot PRs do not get

example-app-service.note: test matrix flakes on recent PRs; deploys on merge; .github/** is expertise-guarded
